KNotes

  • All data on this page are simulated (participants SIM-001 to SIM-010, dates in 2027). Some errors were planted on purpose so the data checks have something to find.
  • Study day: C1D1 is day 1; days before C1D1 are negative (there is no day 0). Baseline for % change is the last value on or before C1D1.
  • RECIST 1.1 (derived) is recalculated from the target lesion diameters the site recorded: partial response at a 30% or greater decrease from baseline, progression at a 20% and 5 mm or greater increase from the smallest previous sum, or any new lesion or unequivocal non-target progression; a missing measurement makes the time point not evaluable. Responses are unconfirmed. The investigator's response is shown alongside.
  • RECIP 1.0 and the FDG PET/CT criteria are shown as recorded by the site. The protocol's primary endpoint is PSMA-PFS by RECIP 1.0.
  • Platelet lines follow protocol Table 7; haemoglobin and neutrophil lines are CTCAE grade thresholds; normal ranges come from the site laboratory reference file.
  • Nothing has been corrected: values that look wrong are plotted as recorded, marked with an x, and listed in section I.
  • In the interactive charts, hover for details, click a legend entry to hide or show it, and use the camera icon to save a PNG.
